name: Mike Mazzei
summary:
Michael Paul Mazzei (born May 30, 1965) is an  American politician who is the governor-elect of Oklahoma. A member of the Republican Party, he served in the Oklahoma Senate from 2004 to 2016 and as the Oklahoma secretary of budget from 2019 to 2020.
In the 2026 Oklahoma gubernatorial election, he defeated Cyndi Munson and became the governor-elect of Oklahoma.
